Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model, reviewed_by is null; no hardware was attached and no upstream simulator run or hardware run is claimed. The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver decision was used unchanged, so there is no deviation. The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the simulator is NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab with Python 3.11 (srb/__main__.py:37-40, docs/src/README.md:7), which is not installed where the gate runs; package code never imports the clone, so the package fake (fake.py) is the only backend and the upstream sim path was not run. The fake is a kinematic F0 stand-in for the srb/_manipulation template, not a copy of the exemplar: it reproduces the action-rate reward term and the reset joint-offset range, but not rigid-body dynamics, contacts, torque/acceleration/contact rewards, or the upstream seed stream. NOT COVERED: the upstream state and state_dyn contact-force observation groups (robot- and scene-dependent shapes); the fake returns only proprio and proprio_dyn with a seven-joint vector, a constant 3D position and a constant 6D rotation. The fake's six-element action Box width is placeholder test data mirroring the default Franka relative pose action; only the per-element -1..1 bound (srb/core/env/common/base/direct/impl.py:354-355) is upstream code, while the upstream width is action_manager.total_action_dim. The fake truncates at 500 agent steps, derived from episode_length_s 10.0 at agent_rate 1/50, not a directly stated upstream constant. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge only records the seed for the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT twice for reset and step, which come from Isaac Lab's DirectRLEnv outside the clone (srb/core/env/common/base/direct/impl.py:7), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.values). G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
